notes.title: MAFATE - Update v0.3.6
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147019/544c1889113571eb9209c5e1c466979e2cd84fed.png"][/img][/h1][h1]MAFATE - Update v0.3.6[/h1][p] Hello everyone! 👋  We’ve just released a small but important update to the **Pre-alpha Demo**.  [/p][p][/p][p]This patch focuses on polishing visuals and fixing several gameplay issues reported by you.   Thank you for your feedback — it’s helping us make MAFATE better every day! ❤️  ---  [/p][p][/p][h3]✨ Added[/h3][list][*][p] Ambient Occlusion & Decals in Balanced Quality Settings    [/p][/*][*][p] Natacha’s kids’ drawings on Petunia Inn’s walls    [/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠 Fixed[/h3][list][*][p] Collision stuck on Petunia’s house  [/p][/*][*][p] Baby ducks falling into the void  [/p][/*][*][p] Collision issue on Marla’s Duck Bridge  [/p][/*][*][p] P3K not delivering all letters  [/p][p]
 ---  [/p][/*][/list][h3]📬 Keep the feedback coming![/h3][p][/p][p]We’re still in **Pre-alpha**, so every bug report and suggestion counts.  
Join our Discord to share your feedback, report bugs, and be part of the adventure![/p][p]

– [b]The Blue Ramen Studios Team[/b]
